verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication SaaS, not a coding agent or development environment, so auto-detecting and installing toolchains is a category error for this product type. Its MCP support, CLI and agent skills let AI agents operate on Basecamp data. They do not provide an agent environment that provisions toolchains or dependencies, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
